name: What is the process for a floor plan redesign with a general contractor?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a floor plan redesign with a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Next, our team conducts a site visit to assess the existing structure. We then develop preliminary design concepts and floor plans for your review and feedback. Once a design is approved, we handle permit acquisition, material selection, and project scheduling. Construction follows, with regular communication until completion. Simply Construction manages all aspects from concept to final walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes consultation, site assessment, design concepts, permit acquisition, material selection, scheduling, and construction, managed from start to finish.
